title: Isandro and the Contact
author: Tamsin Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Thackeray, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
